pairs.label: Design primer pairs
pairs.description: Pick up to five primer pairs for the authentic human HBB transcript NM_000518.5, with products of 120–220 bases.

internal.label: Design primers and an internal oligo
internal.description: Add internal oligonucleotide selection using the same transcript and product-size range.

constrained.label: Design around a target region
constrained.description: Require primers around target bases 250–299, exclude bases 100–119 and search the specified included region. Boulder-IO coordinates are zero-based.

oligotm.label: Calculate oligonucleotide melting temperature
oligotm.description: Calculate melting temperature for an oligonucleotide from the HBB transcript, using the program defaults.

ntthal.label: Inspect oligonucleotide self-alignment
ntthal.description: Evaluate the thermodynamic alignment of an HBB oligonucleotide with itself.

alignment.label: Align overlapping HBB oligos
alignment.description: Align transcript bases 200–220 and 207–227 with the original local sequence-alignment utility.

amplicon.label: Calculate amplicon melting
amplicon.description: Calculate melting properties of the authentic HBB transcript segment at bases 200–349.

long-tm.label: Calculate long-sequence melting temperature
long-tm.description: Run the original long-sequence utility on all 628 bases of the HBB transcript.

masker.label: Synthetic control: mask a sequence
masker.description: Demonstrate soft masking using an explicitly synthetic sequence and a tiny synthetic 4-mer frequency table. This is not a genome-frequency reference.

help.label: About Primer3
help.description: Show the original program version, authors and copyright information.

primer3.label: Human HBB transcript and synthetic masking control
primer3.description: Authentic 628-base human HBB transcript NM_000518.5, with separate examples for paired primers, an internal oligo and target constraints. Sequence provenance is included. A separate tiny synthetic sequence and 4-mer table demonstrate masking only.
